sources.title: Zarr-Python issue #3169: Stored and computed checksum do not match in case when shards larger than chunks
sources.pin: Issue report for Zarr-Python 3.0.8; captured issue state on 2026-10-06
sources.locator: Issue body reproduction using create_array(data=..., chunks=(1000,100), shards=(5000,500)); symptoms and issue history
sources.applicability: Evidence of a reported sharded create_array checksum failure in the named reproduction. An issue report and workarounds do not establish root cause or general behavior.

sources.title: Zarr-Python PR #3299: fix chunk/shard iteration
sources.locator: PR body and merge status; patch changes chunk/shard iteration and adds iterator/region tests
sources.applicability: Shows repository changes that distinguish inner chunk regions from shard/storage-object regions. Does not by itself verify stored data correctness or application performance.

sources.title: Zarr-Python PR #3422: fix/shard iteration redux
sources.locator: PR body; patch src/zarr/core/array.py _copy_arraylike_region hunk; tests/test_array.py test_create_array_with_data_num_gets (assertion: one metadata GET plus one GET per shard, NumPy/Zarr inputs)
sources.applicability: The second copy path now iterates at shard granularity. The added regression assertion measures GET count, not byte-for-byte equality or the issue's exact CRC failure.

sources.title: Zarr-Python v3.1.3 release
sources.locator: Release notes list PR #3422 (fix/shard iteration redux)
sources.applicability: Release context for the identified fix. Does not assert RAM use, atomic project saves, or behavior on the proposed application's inputs.

sources.title: Zarr v3 Sharding codec specification
sources.pin: Sharding codec specification version 1.0 as stated on page; latest-route response captured 2026-10-06, SHA-pinned capture
sources.locator: Abstract and definitions: shards contain inner chunks and correspond to storage objects; implementation notes on full-shard reads/writes and synchronization; configuration chunk_shape
sources.applicability: Normative storage-format background for chunk versus shard granularity. The latest route is mutable; the capture hash and stated codec version identify the observed content.

sources.title: napari issue #8353: Points layer handles scaling (pixel spacing) incorrectly, Points.csv has wrong numbers
sources.pin: Issue state open; captured 2026-10-06; reporter environment napari 0.6.4
sources.locator: Issue body: 8x8 ITK/MHD image origin=(100,100), spacing=(2,2), GUI-created Points CSV values near (50,50) and (57,57), expected world values (100,100) and (114,114)
sources.applicability: Concrete user report and repro for one napari 0.6.4/reader/layer-creation path. Not a resolved bug or proof of all points exports.

sources.title: napari issue #8353 discussion
sources.pin: Comments captured 2026-10-06; issue remained open in captured issue state
sources.locator: Comments by napari participants: layer data coordinates versus world coordinates; CSV stores data without layer transform; creation order affects inherited scale/translate; 2026-09-18 comments ask about save/load and propose metadata-bearing writer; no merged repair identified
sources.applicability: Discussion clarifies coordinate semantics and open state, but is not implementation or regression-test evidence.

sources.title: napari v0.6.4 tag and release notes
sources.pin: Tag v0.6.4 resolves to commit 8aa6ea45b0fce8ff2a9506d75b55a93fc8ac9589 (annotated tag object 11ca6032f62d0702d5c0c1524185a43e84b7840d)
sources.locator: Annotated tag release description identifies napari as a multidimensional image viewer built on Qt, VisPy and scientific Python stack
sources.applicability: Exact viewer source pin used for evaluation of candidate fit. Does not establish embedding compatibility or coordinate/export behavior in the proposed shell.

sources.title: OME-NGFF specification version 0.5
sources.pin: Version 0.5 page; its captured revision history includes 0.5.2 dated 2025-01-10; capture SHA pins the observed live page
sources.locator: Sections 2.1 axes, 2.3 coordinateTransformations, 2.4 multiscales; revision history
sources.applicability: Metadata/storage convention for axes and scale/translation transforms, not a whole local-project, arbitrary-transform or annotation interchange contract.

sources.title: tifffile README and examples at the MMStack metadata fix commit
sources.pin: Git commit 6e0a02f10fc763abd94aee0a0ab8225b4b8860a9; README content identifies 2026.9.9 while the source commit updates tifffile.py to 2026.9.15
sources.locator: Quickstart/examples: TiffFile series shape/dtype/axes inspection; return_as='zarr' and selected-region access for TIFF-backed Zarr arrays; notes on TIFF/OME-TIFF scope and limitations
sources.applicability: Candidate TIFF inspection and bounded-access entry points with documented format limits. Examples are documentation, not evidence that every layout stays within a 3 GB application's memory budget.

sources.title: tifffile issue #334: numeric Summary values stored as strings in Micro-Manager MMStack
sources.locator: Issue reproduction and reporter's archived MMStack metadata/calibration failure; maintainer links the behavior to 2026.9.15
sources.applicability: Evidence of one legacy metadata compatibility failure. It does not establish general support for MMStack.

sources.title: tifffile fix commit for MMStack string calibration values
sources.locator: Diff in tifffile/tifffile.py: float conversion of PixelSize_um, z-step_um and Interval_ms with TypeError/ValueError fallback; revision/changelog line says fix MMStack series when numeric Summary metadata values are strings (#334)
sources.applicability: Fix is visible in source and version/changelog text. Captured commit lists only tifffile.py; no automated regression test was added there, so this is not a complete issue/fix/test chain.

sources.title: Zarr Vectors draft specification
sources.pin: Live draft documentation captured 2026-10-06; page explicitly describes itself as a draft released to spark conversation
sources.locator: Opening abstract and contents: chunked spatial vector data; points, polylines, meshes, tracks; Zarr v3; geometry and indexing sections
sources.applicability: Optional future precedent for spatially indexed large vector annotations. Draft status means it should be evaluated, not treated as a stable requirement or adopted schema.

sources.title: zarr-vectors Python implementation documentation
sources.pin: Latest documentation response captured 2026-10-06; mutable route, capture SHA identifies observed content
sources.locator: Opening overview and API surface: claims spatially indexed vector data in Zarr v3, distinguishes public api/building modules from internal modules, documents stability query
sources.applicability: Public implementation docs identify an evolving Python API and stability boundary. No package was installed or executed, and no compatibility with this project was tested.
